endpoint_A2_multimodal_admission_primary.definition: A2(c,a) = 1 iff the item passes ALL v1 gates AND the three ECM-v2 gates G6/G7/G8. No v1 condition is relaxed, so A2 is a strict subset of v1 admission by construction.
endpoint_A2_multimodal_admission_primary.which_gate_carried_it: read per_gate_pass_per_arm: G6 is load-bearing and has no chance baseline; G7 and G8 are corroborating and weak, with measured chance rates recorded in the pre-registration.

endpoint_necessity_margin_secondary.endpoint: M(c,a) = min over gate-passing judges of visual_necessity (not thresholded)

frame.floor_clause: ROUND4_NECESSITY_ADDENDUM.md section 4 floor clause applies only below n=40. Frame F materialised at n=60, above the floor and above the frozen target of 46, so Holm rejection flags are live and significance claims are permitted. n was fixed before the first call and not adjusted afterwards.
frame.name: F_hul_law_textbook_sections_role_conditioned

judge_record_completeness_per_arm.how_to_read: NOT_ATTEMPTED means the paired generation did not pass its gate, so no judge call was made; that is admission attrition and it is arm-dependent by construction. TERMINAL_FAILURE is a judge-side failure and is not.
judge_record_completeness_per_arm.why: ROUND4_NECESSITY_ADDENDUM.md section 2.1 item 5: judge-record completeness per arm must be visible, because a per-arm asymmetry biases every pooling rule that requires both judges.

other_judged_vectors.unaveraged_note: distribution is the primary form; mean is derived from it for readability and carries no test
other_judged_vectors.why: ROUND4_NECESSITY_ADDENDUM.md section 2.1 item 4: the four judged vectors other than visual_necessity, per arm, unaveraged. These are declared secondary and are NOT confirmatory: no Holm control is applied to them and no significance claim is made from them.

strata.why: both splits are frozen in ROUND4_FRAMEF_PREREGISTRATION.json before execution. figure_role reads on whether the effect depends on figure kind; question_type isolates the multiple-choice subset, which is graded without any string heuristic. Descriptive, not confirmatory: no Holm control is applied to them and no significance claim is made from them.

quotation_provenance_taxonomy.strict_channel_rule: a quotation counts as image-channel only if it carries a word of >= 6 characters that appears in the figure's recognised lettering and NOT in the source text; the loose one-word form produced false positives on frames D and E
quotation_provenance_taxonomy.why: ROUND4_FRAMEF_PREREGISTRATION secondary endpoint. The provenance claim is the one result that reproduced across frames C, D and E, so it is recomputed here on the same strict definition.
